03 · /pages/dr-angela-wright

Advisory partner

Dr Angela Wright

GP, Clinical Sexologist & Menopause Specialist
MBBS · Member of the British Menopause Society (Registered Specialist) · Fellow of the European Committee of Sexual Medicine
18 sec · “Why I started talking about pleasure in a clinic”
Shop what she recommends ↗ Work with her

Her story

Angela spent fifteen years as an NHS GP before training in sexual medicine, after noticing how many consultations ended with a woman apologising for raising the subject at all.

She now runs a menopause and sexual medicine practice in the UK, sits on our advisory board, and reviews every clinical claim we make before it goes live.

What she gets asked most

  • “Is it normal that sex hurts now?”
  • “Will sensation come back after cancer treatment?”
  • “Is vaginal oestrogen safe for me?”
  • “Am I too old for this to matter?”

Work with Wright

Angela sees patients privately in the UK and takes referrals for menopause, painful sex and post-cancer sexual health.

Hello Nancy takes no commission on any booking made through this page.

Referrals & clinic →
“Self-stimulators now appear in international consensus recommendations, most recently the 2026 GSM consensus, alongside lubrication and pelvic floor therapy. For the wider population the evidence is still growing, but the direction is clear: this is a recognised part of sexual wellbeing, not a novelty.”
Dr Angela Wright · on the evidence behind what we sell · wording approved by her, August 2026
